hero_subheading: Did you receive a suspicious message, call, email, or payment request?
hero_body: Cyber Saathi helps ordinary people — students, parents, and senior citizens — understand what to do when something online feels wrong. Choose a situation below to get clear, simple guidance.
scenarios_section_subheading: Tap the situation that matches what happened to you.
scenario_message_desc: Received a strange WhatsApp, SMS, or chat message asking you to click a link or share details?
scenario_call_desc: Got a call from someone claiming to be a bank, police, TRAI, or government officer?
scenario_video_desc: Received a suspicious video call, or someone is threatening you using a recorded or fake video?
scenario_email_desc: Got an email asking you to verify your account, pay a fee, or click an urgent link?
scenario_link_desc: Someone sent you a link and you are unsure if it is safe to open?
scenario_upi_desc: Received a payment request, QR code, or an OTP-related call connected to your bank or UPI?
scenario_courier_desc: Got a message or call saying your parcel is held or contains illegal items?
scenario_social_desc: Received a suspicious friend request, job offer, investment tip, or threatening message on social media?
scenario_deepfake_desc: Received a suspicious voice message, morphed image, or video that looks or sounds like someone you know?

resources_subheading: Trusted, official channels for reporting cyber fraud in India.
resources_1930_desc: Call 1930 immediately if you have lost money to an online scam. This is India's national helpline for financial cyber fraud.
resources_portal_desc: File a complaint online for phishing, fake calls, social media fraud, or any other cybercrime.
resources_bank_label: Contact Your Bank or Payment Provider
resources_bank_desc: If you shared bank or UPI details, call your bank's official helpline immediately and ask them to secure or freeze your account.
resources_tip_otp: Never share your OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN, CVV or password with anyone — not even someone who claims to be from your bank.
resources_tip_verify: Always verify using the official website or app. Do not trust numbers or links sent in a message.
resources_tip_2fa: Turn on two-step verification (2FA) on your email, WhatsApp, and banking apps where available.
resources_tip_password: If you entered your password on a suspicious page, change it immediately through the official website or app.
resources_tip_evidence: Take screenshots of suspicious messages before deleting them — they are useful evidence when reporting.
resources_tip_forward: Do not forward suspicious messages to others — this spreads the scam.
resources_disclaimer: This page links only to official government resources. Cyber Saathi does not provide legal or financial advice.
about_hero_desc: A student-developed cyber-awareness project designed to make online safety easier to understand for everyone.
about_what_body: Cyber Saathi provides simple, practical, step-by-step guidance for people who may not have technical knowledge. It helps users recognise and respond to suspicious messages, phone calls, video calls, emails, malicious links, UPI and payment scams, fake courier messages, social media impersonation and AI-generated deepfake scams.
about_mission_body: To make cyber safety easier to understand and accessible to people with different levels of digital knowledge. Cyber Saathi aims to help users recognise common online scams, take safer actions and find appropriate reporting resources when they need help.
about_feature_scenarios: Practical scenario-based cyber safety guidance for 9 common scam types.
about_feature_languages: Full support for English, Hindi and Marathi.
about_feature_quiz: Interactive 10-question Cyber Safety Quiz with instant feedback.
about_feature_resources: Trusted cybercrime reporting resources including 1930 helpline and cybercrime.gov.in.
about_feature_simple: Simple instructions designed for non-technical users.
about_feature_responsive: Responsive design — works on desktop and mobile devices.
about_tech_body: Cyber Saathi is built entirely with plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks or external dependencies. Content is localised using JSON-based language files, and language preference is saved using browser localStorage. It can be deployed for free on any static hosting service.
about_tech_note: This is a cyber-awareness and educational guidance website. It does not automatically detect scams or connect to any external service.
about_disclaimer: The information on this website is for general awareness only. Always verify with official government sources.
